title: From the row to the laws
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-11, conditional on ticket A. At n = 2^m, K_n is the block operator of RETURN-LAW-20261110-001C (Theorem 7) on V_L + V_R, the n - 1 rows of the first and last columns of the v-grid. Its corner row e_(L,0) K_n^-1 has 2(n - 1) entries rho_(X,b)(s) in GF(2)(s), X in {L, R}, b = 0, ..., n - 2: rho_(L,b)(w^2) is the series of the walks from c = (0, 1) to the v contact (0, 2b + 1) and rho_(R,b)(w^2) to (N, 2b + 1), N = 2n - 2 (the decomposition counts exactly the walks that end on an end column). Known: rho_(L,0) = 1/(1 + L(s^2)) at 4 to 512 (C1, exact) and rho_(R,n-2) = s^(2n-1)/(1 + L(s^2)) (the far corner, computed to 128). Targets B1 (the rule is the row for every m, proving C1) and B2 (the count of B137 from the row and its vanishing at every power of two from 8), with criteria frozen in proof.md. Retired without work unless ticket A's full rule passes at side 64.
failure_conditions: The rule of ticket A fails at a side from 4 to 128.
The count obtained from the row does not vanish at a power of two from 8 to 128.
remaining_obligations: B1 by proof for every m, or the lemma that would finish it
B2 by proof, or the lemma that would finish it
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), and its walk over GF(2) at the powers of two. The row is a contact-level reading (A45).
